leagues.quote: It is the league's fifth season to be divided into two championships: the Apertura and the Clausura, each in an identical format ... The season was played in a round robin style, with the top four 4 making the playoffs.
leagues.note: 9 clubs (Guayama FC and FC Mayaguez left, nobody joined; the article still says 'eight teams' in one sentence), round robin, top 4 to the play-offs; each tournament crowns its own champion and a Supercopa pits the Apertura winner against the Clausura winner. Apertura 2026 starts 15 August and its end is only 'December 2026' (round 17 was played 18-19 November, play-offs in December). Clausura 2027 has no data at all; the league's pattern is Clausura in January-May (Clausura 2026 ran into May 2026). No promotion or relegation. The database row holds only the Apertura (15 August - 29 November).
